dependency: B1 expanded homogeneous-face outcome must be known before Gate C implementation is admitted

physical_contract.interface_pressure_head: single continuous h_interface shared by both materials
physical_contract.flux_conservation: q_upper_half = q_lower_half; one realized face flux is used once as upper-cell outflow and once as lower-cell inflow
physical_contract.identical_material_reduction: heterogeneous route must reduce to the qualified homogeneous-face result within tolerance when both material references are identical
physical_contract.mass_conservation: absolute requirement; interface solve tolerance may affect head residual but may not create a second inconsistent face flux

required_regimes: both cells unsaturated over wet, intermediate and dry states
multiple upper/lower half-face lengths and asymmetric geometry

required_oracles.primary: independent steady Darcy two-material shooting BVP with continuous pressure head and conservative q
required_oracles.secondary: homogeneous-limit identity when material references become equal

acceptance_metrics_predeclared.equal_flux_residual: report absolute and scaled residual; realized face flux must be single-valued
acceptance_metrics_predeclared.interface_head_error_vs_darcy_oracle: report median, p90, p99 and maximum
acceptance_metrics_predeclared.face_flux_error_vs_darcy_oracle: report active relative error and dormant absolute/Ks-scaled error
acceptance_metrics_predeclared.root_iterations: report p50, p90, p99 and maximum, including bracket expansions
acceptance_metrics_predeclared.continuity: refinement test under decreasing perturbations of each adjacent cell head and geometry; left/right agreement alone is insufficient
acceptance_metrics_predeclared.homogeneous_reduction: test exact same-material substitution separately from merely similar materials
acceptance_metrics_predeclared.fail_closed: no extrapolation outside admitted material/head/geometry envelope

architecture.scratch: interface bracket/root work remains worker scratch
architecture.shared_data: material MFP and any qualified correction tables remain immutable shared parameter/template data
architecture.solver_policy: LayeredMFP remains explicit physical solver configuration, not a performance policy
architecture.response_tangent: not admitted by Gate C unless separately demonstrated
